blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Singapore’s fencers may not have the opportunity to try and match their record haul of eight gold medals at the 2025 SEA Games, after several key events were dropped from the 2027 edition in Malaysia. This, after the South-east Asian Games Federation (SEAGF) on Oct 30 approved the final programme for the 34th SEA Games, which will be held from Sept 18 to 29, 2027, across four main locations: Kuala Lumpur, Sarawak, Penang and Johor. The programme features 100 fewer medal events than the 2025 Games in Thailand, with the cuts affecting both entire sports and individual events in sports that […]...
